card.name: Linking words before university names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (and, at, comma) right before a university or institution name in lists of schools and academic affiliations. Also seen inside a few capitalised names or acronyms.

modes.label: Before university names
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or 'at' that comes just before the next university or lab in a list or affiliation.
modes.example: Duke University, Louisiana State University<<,>> Stony Brook University, University of Pittsburgh

modes.label: Inside names and acronyms
modes.description: The start of a foreign-language name or acronym expansion, partway through the term.
modes.example: Translated from<< Ch>>agatai Turkic by Annette

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a proper name, such as a university, rather than common words.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word or comma just before the next university name in a list of schools.
